# Sparrowgate

Sparrowgate is a customer onboarding platform for B2B software companies. It replaces the
scattered mix of welcome emails, help-centre links and ad-hoc calls that most teams assemble by
hand.

## Why onboarding matters

Onboarding is critically important to the health of a subscription business. Companies that
take it seriously see meaningful improvements across their key metrics, and the benefits
compound over time. Getting it right early pays dividends later.

## What Sparrowgate does

Sparrowgate builds a guided setup path for each new account and tracks where accounts stall.
When an account has not reached its first successful outcome within a configured window, the
platform notifies the assigned account manager and suggests the next step based on where the
account stopped.

## Results

Our customers see excellent results. Teams using Sparrowgate report much better retention and
significantly improved activation rates compared to their previous approach. The impact on
revenue is substantial.

## Integrations

Sparrowgate connects to Salesforce, HubSpot, and Segment, and exposes a webhook for systems not
on that list.
